_comment: LinusAddons Conditional Render Boxes. Edit this file, save it, then run /la reload — no restart needed.
_howToUse: Each object in 'boxes' defines one box rendered in world space.
A box is only drawn when ALL of its 'conditions' pass (AND logic).
For OR logic, add two boxes at the same position with different conditions.
Run '/la createWaypoint' while standing in-game to create a new box at your position.
Run '/la reload' after editing this file to apply changes without restarting.

boxFields.label: name, shown in logs and command output.
boxFields.center: [x, y, z] — world-space centre of the box.
boxFields.sizeX: Width  on the X axis. Default: 1.0
boxFields.sizeY: Height on the Y axis. Default: 1.0
boxFields.sizeZ: Depth  on the Z axis. Default: 1.0
boxFields.color: [R, G, B] or [R, G, B, A] — each 0-255. Alpha defaults to 255.

conditionFields.type: MUST_BE_EMPTY | MAX_SIZE_MEDIUM | MAX_SIZE_MINI | OCCUPIED | MIN_SIZE | EXACT_SIZE
conditionFields.size: Only for MIN_SIZE / EXACT_SIZE: EMPTY | MINI | MEDIUM | BIG

boxes._comment: Example — green outline: safe spot when box 1 is empty AND box 3 has at most a medium tentacle
boxes.label: Left safe (1 empty, 3 <= medium)

boxes._comment: Example — red filled+outline warning when box 2 has a big tentacle
boxes.label: Box 2 big danger
